newsitem.title: UK: Britain's trade surplus best for 10 years - minister.
newsitem.headline: Britain's trade surplus best for 10 years - minister.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics (ONS) said Britain had a second quarter current account surplus of 792 million pounds ($1.3 billion), against a previous estimate of a 457 million surplus and following a first quarter 1.276 billion deficit.
The British Treasury's economic secretary, Angela Knight, said Thursday's balance of payments data represented the best performance in a decade.
"This is the best trading performance in 10 years. It confirms the UK as a strong international trading country," she said in a statement given by a Treasury official.
The ONS also said third quarter gross domestic product was up an unrevised 0.8 percent. The figure was in line with analysts' expectations. ($1=.5950 Pound)
